answer: Make every grading seat post a refundable bond, forfeited if the grader approves a planted honeypot. Suppose an operator runs forty clones grading survey reports about a coastal lagoon. Honest graders check each claim and catch the bait report swearing yarrow grows underwater on the tidal flats; clones following one script approve it together, and all forty bonds burn at once. That is the ridge between honest and fake seats: independent judgment is free, correlated judgment is expensive.
